simulation.title: Revenue Recognition & Cut-off Audit Digital Twin

learning_outcomes: Identify revenue and cut-off risks from a frozen evidence pack
Map risks to assertions and design responsive audit procedures
Challenge AI recommendations using contradictory evidence
learning_contract.professional_judgment_expected: Accept, modify, reject, request more evidence, or escalate an AI-supported audit conclusion.

research_grounding.evidence_gap_note: Template example only. Before promotion to Research-Backed status, add verified directly relevant FT50/AJG 4*/4 research anchors or retain the evidence-gap label.

standards_regulation.rights_note: Do not reproduce protected standards text; link to the applicable official source.

evidence_data.source_name: Synthetic Client XYZ frozen revenue evidence pack
evidence_data.leakage_check: Gold labels must not be exposed to provider/model generation.
evidence_data.authoritative_status: Synthetic teaching evidence; not external authoritative evidence.

digital_twin.evidence_boundary: Only the frozen evidence pack and explicitly approved contextual sources may be used.
digital_twin.gold_label_visibility_rule: Blind Gold is evaluator-only during AI generation.

ai_condition.evidence_access_boundary: Approved evidence only; no Blind Gold access.

assessment.construct_validity_note: Educational/research measures require documented validity evidence before high-stakes interpretation.
assessment.learning_retention_plan: Use pre/post or delayed assessment when the simulation is used for empirical education research.

sustainability_value.people: Consider effects on employees, investors, customers and professional accountability where material.
sustainability_value.planet: NOT_MATERIAL unless the revenue scenario has material environmental consequences; document the rationale.
sustainability_value.society: Consider reporting trust, market integrity and public-interest implications.
sustainability_value.sustainable_profit: Consider whether revenue judgments reflect durable economic value rather than short-term reporting incentives.

human_gate.responsible_role: Student judgment reviewed by instructor/human reviewer
